title: noronhia olearia
intro: Noronhia olearia, commonly known as the Madagascar almond or Olearia tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Oleeaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Madagascar, and is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Noronhia olearia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Noronhia olearia include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
